$description: s277-D9 — a declared SCOPE per guideline file: how a rule reaches the components it governs when the file binds a FACET (copy, colour, type, icons …) rather than a component. HAND-AUTHORED (#279 lane SC), read by knowledge/_compose_slice.py (obeys class `routed-by-scope`, ASK Q2). Sibling of _rules-index.json because gen_rules_index.py rewrites that file whole and would drop any added key. `obeys` on a meta stays the specific, authored binding (s274-D12); this is inference by declared scope, with an exception row per rule the file's scope must NOT carry.
$sourceRule: every $source is a verbatim sentence or clause of the named file, matched as a substring after collapsing runs of whitespace to one space (the files hard-wrap at ~90 columns). Markdown ** marks are outside the quoted span.
$joinRule: a rule in file F reaches component C when (a) F.kind == component and C is in F.components, or (b) F.kind == facet and C's meta binds one of F's facets: a token group named under facets[f].binds.tokenGroups appears in the meta's `tokens` block (same TOKEN_PATH_RX walk as tokens_for), or a meta field named under binds.metaFields is present and non-empty, or an edge of a type under binds.edges leaves C (usesIcon/usesLogo from the ratified node files, renderedBy from the meta). Authored `components` on a facet row add to (b). A rule listed in F.exceptions never routes. A row with kind null routes nothing.

motion.$why: motion/* tokens or a meta `motion` block — the component moves

elevation.$why: elevation/*, blur/* or overlay/* — the component is raised or scrims

layout.$why: grid/spacing groups or a meta `responsive` block — the component lays out against the grid

interaction.$why: focus/* or target/* tokens, or a meta `interactive`/`stateModel` block — the component takes input

markup.$why: a renderedBy snippet — the component has markup; effectively every rendered component

forms.$why: form/* semantic tokens — the component is a form control or field

data-vis.$why: data/*, data-vis/* or the dataviz component-type group — the component plots data

status.$why: rag/* semantic tokens — the component carries RAG status colour

media.$why: DECLARED: no token group, meta field or edge carries audio/video today — reach only by an authored component (video-player)
